title: Unique Springy Vietnamese Pork Nem Nuong
description: A cultured and springy Vietnamese dish featuring cardamom, perfect for midnight cravings, made with Mediterranean-friendly ingredients in a nem nuong form and served in a hot pot vessel.

ingredients.name: ground pork
ingredients.notes: preferably with some fat content for flavor

instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine the ground pork, fish sauce, cardamom powder, garlic, shallots, black pepper, and salt, then mix well with a whisk until just combined.
Cover the mixture and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes to allow the flavors to meld.
Preheat a hot pot vessel or a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Using your hands, shape the pork mixture into small cylinders, about 1 inch in diameter and 2 inches long.
Add the rice vinegar to the hot pot vessel or skillet and bring to a simmer.
Add the bruised lemongrass to the simmering vinegar and cook for 2 minutes.
Add the pork cylinders to the hot pot vessel or skillet, leaving some space between each piece to allow for even cooking.
Cook the nem nuong for 5-7 minutes on each side, or until they are cooked through and slightly charred.
Serve the nem nuong hot, garnished with additional sliced shallots and a sprinkle of black pepper if desired.
